questions.stemHtml: A technology company is testing a new sensor designed to measure ambient light intensity and its effect on plant growth. The sensor readings are taken at different light intensities (X) and corresponding plant growth measurements (Y) are recorded. The data is then plotted on a graph as shown in the figure below. What conclusion can be drawn from the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: There is a spurious correlation between the two variables

options.label: B
options.text: There is a constant negative correlation between two variables

options.label: C
options.text: There is a constant positive correlation between two variables
